workflow.title: Setup · Install or link JADO
workflow.summary: Choose local, global or linked setup, prepare selected tools and migrate design instructions.
workflow.notes: Follow jado-install for the plan, semantic migration and access verification. Local and global setup give selected JADO skills priority with backups; external packages come from upstream. Linking updates project entry points. Apply updates through the CLI for the selected destination.
inputs: JADO source and local or global destination
outputs: Migrated design instructions and setup verification

nodes.label: Choose setup destination
nodes.detail: Locate the JADO source and choose local, global or linked setup.

nodes.label: Read installation procedure
nodes.detail: Follow jado-install. Setup is a separate assignment from product work.

nodes.label: Read instructions and configuration
nodes.detail: Inspect effective entries, overrides, linked Markdown, nested rules and Git state. For global setup inspect the tools' user-level instructions. Preserve product documents and existing UX artifact locations until migration is verified.

nodes.label: Choose mode and tools
nodes.detail: Reuse received choices. Local is self-contained; global manages the user-level method and upstream dependencies; linked setup adds a project entry. Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode have native adapters; other skills CLI targets receive skills only in local setup.

nodes.label: Does an entry already exist?
nodes.detail: Inspect the effective instructions at the selected destination.

nodes.label: Prepare a JADO entry
nodes.detail: Prepare a concise method pointer while preserving project constraints.

nodes.label: Prepare design migration
nodes.detail: Update the effective entry and reached files. Replace incompatible routers while preserving domain, design system, verification, Git and release rules.

nodes.label: Prepare the setup plan
nodes.detail: Run install, link or update with --dry-run and retain the revision. The plan shows files, references and conflicts; router replacement also needs a semantic migration diff.

nodes.label: Review the setup diff
nodes.detail: Review proposed destination files and instruction changes before applying them. Honor authorization already supplied in the task.

nodes.label: Apply authorized changes
nodes.detail: Apply the reviewed plan with --yes and --revision HASH. The CLI checks collisions and hashes and retains backups. Apply the reviewed instruction diff with verified backup; commit or push needs its own authorization.

nodes.label: Verify access and profiles
nodes.detail: Check diff, links, catalog and instructions. For linked setup verify external reads in the AI session as well as the CLI. Use a local copy if external access is blocked. Verify route and available native profiles in a fresh session.

nodes.label: Is setup verified?
nodes.detail: Distinguish completed checks from prepared files still awaiting load verification or a missing requirement.

nodes.label: Deliver verified setup
nodes.detail: Return source, changed files and instructions with completed checks.

nodes.label: Report remaining setup checks
nodes.detail: Return prepared setup and state missing requirements or verification; generated files alone do not prove native execution.
